categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Bingo Software Co., Ltd. primarily operates in cloud computing and industry informatization services. Its business includes cloud product sales, cloud solutions (consulting, custom development, system integration, and operation & maintenance), cloud leasing services, and industry-specific informatization projects. The company offers full-stack enterprise cloud platforms covering IaaS, PaaS, DaaS, and SaaS layers, targeting sectors such as government, public security, military, rail transit, finance, and education.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary cloud computing technologies including heterogeneous cloud resource management, software-defined networking, high-performance load balancing, container orchestration, and cloud-native architectures. It has developed core products like BingoCloudOS, BingoFuse, BingoInsight, and BingoLink, supporting multi-architecture chip compatibility and autonomous control. R&D focuses on cloud-edge-end collaboration, domestic substitution of foreign technologies, AI large model integration, intelligent computing power scheduling, and blockchain-based data sharing, with continuous innovation in software-defined data centers and AI-driven platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are government agencies, public security departments, military, rail transit operators, financial institutions, educational organizations, and large enterprises. The company serves primarily large-scale institutional clients requiring private or dedicated cloud infrastructure and industry-specific digital transformation solutions. Its market presence is strong in vertical sectors such as government, rail transit, public security, and military industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant business in South China, North China, Central China, East China, West China, and Northeast China regions. It has a strong presence in Guangzhou (headquarters) and extends services nationwide across 29 provinces and 7 major industry sectors.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangzhou Bingo Software operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the cloud computing supply chain. It develops and sells cloud software products, provides cloud infrastructure solutions, system integration, and cloud services to end customers. The company also invests in upstream chip design and hardware integration to support domestic substitution and ecosystem development.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on building a 'cloud-data foundation platform' driven by vertical AI and domestic computing power ecosystems. R&D priorities include autonomous and controllable cloud computing technologies, cloud-edge-end collaboration, AI large model fusion, intelligent computing power scheduling, and domestic chip ecosystem integration. The company invests heavily in innovation, patent development, and industry-specific cloud solutions, aiming to lead in full-stack autonomous cloud solutions for vertical industries.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through cloud product sales, cloud solution development (including consulting, customization, integration, and maintenance), and cloud leasing services. The company primarily uses a direct sales model via bidding and tenders for government and large enterprise clients, supplemented by limited distributor sales. Revenue recognition follows contract completion, usage-based billing, and subscription models for cloud leasing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic private cloud and industry cloud service provider with strong capabilities in autonomous cloud technology and domestic substitution. It competes in a market with increasing competition from public cloud providers and other private cloud vendors. Its competitive advantages include proprietary core technologies, comprehensive full-stack cloud products, and deep vertical industry expertise, especially in government, rail transit, and public security sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 520 million, a 4.81% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 64 million, reflecting a significant increase in losses. Total assets grew by 5.98% to nearly RMB 1.99 billion. R&D investment remained stable at around 11.8% of revenue. The company has a workforce of 893 employees, with 193 in R&D. Despite recent losses, the company maintains a solid asset base and continues investing in growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary, original innovation in cloud computing software with high autonomy and security. Its cloud products support a wide range of domestic chips and operating systems, ensuring hardware neutrality and compatibility. It offers full-stack cloud solutions tailored to vertical industries, integrating cloud, edge, and AI computing capabilities. The company’s unique value lies in its comprehensive domestic substitution ecosystem, advanced cloud-native technologies, and deep industry integration, enabling secure, efficient, and scalable digital transformation for government and enterprise clients.
